hooks.name: zero-disk-guard
hooks.description: Ask the agent to review saved web, engine and detector code against the security steering (kiro-workbench Requirement 2.2).

action.prompt: Review the saved file against `.kiro/steering/security.md`. Report any code that writes audio to disk or browser storage, sends audio or scores to a non-self origin, logs audio or user file names, or adds a recording/upload/transcription dependency. Reply 'clean' if none. Do not edit files.
